_readme: Per-club content for the sign-off page. Authored by the League, kept in the
repo so every flag is reviewable in a diff rather than typed into a database.
Club-specific, not a generic preamble. Inline HTML allowed.
note   OPTIONAL. The opening summary is generated from what the page actually
found, so this is only for a genuinely club-specific remark on top of
it. Leave it out unless there is something to say.
fixed  things we corrected on their behalf. Shown in green so the club can
catch us if we got one wrong. Tidying only — de-duplication is not
listed, that was the form being used twice and is nobody's business.
check  what we still need. { ask, why } — `ask` is the instruction and is
all most people will read, so make it an imperative: 'Add a job
title', 'Confirm the capacity'. `why` is one line of context
underneath and is optional. Keys: info:<field>, list:<mailingList>,
people:<Full Name>:<Section> — anchored per role, so a media question
never appears under someone's commercial entry.
apply  the machine-readable form of `fixed`. Merging duplicate people happens — the edits actually made to the
record before it is rendered. Keep the two in step: anything claimed
in `fixed` must have a matching entry here, or the page contradicts

info:capacity.ask: Confirm the capacity, and how much of it is seated.
info:capacity.why: You've sent 9,800. We hold 11,800 on file.

people:Jon Goodwin:Media & marketing.ask: Tell us if Head of Media is wrong.
people:Jon Goodwin:Media & marketing.why: That's what we'll show here otherwise. You cover commercial and media, and we'd rather each role carried its own title.

people:Mike Coulson:Club secretary.ask: Say if these details should stay off the directory.
people:Mike Coulson:Club secretary.why: They're marked not for publication, but we'd normally publish a club secretary contact, so we'll include them unless you tell us otherwise.

fixed: Frazer Bell's job title read Head of Sports Science and edical. We've made that Medical.
Lucy Weston's number was entered as 0330 0945930 Opt 1. We've moved the menu option into the extension field so the number dials on its own.

list:dlo.ask: Send contact details for Teressa Mulholland.
list:dlo.why: We hold none, and as your disability liaison officer we need a direct route.

list:plo.ask: Send contact details for Jonny Sunley.
list:plo.why: Same again for your police liaison officer.

people:James Tose:Community.ask: Send contact details for the Community Sports Trust.
people:James Tose:Community.why: We hold no email address or phone number.

list:slo.why: We have SMSA and the smsa@ address, which is fine to keep alongside a name.

people:TBC:Medical.ask: Tell us who your medical contact is.
people:TBC:Medical.why: This came through as TBC. If the post is vacant we'll leave it off until it's filled.

people:Bradley Rice:Directors.ask: Say if these details should stay off the directory.
people:Bradley Rice:Directors.why: Your director entry is marked not for publication but your commercial one isn't.
